response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but his profile does not align with the core mandatory requirements of this role. His C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. His career is overwhelmingly web/backend focused (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), with a Linux/cloud rather than Windows orientation. He also lacks SQL Server/Oracle depth (SQL/MySQL/MongoDB listed generically) and has no fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital is fintech/wealth-adjacent but not capital markets. Strong fundamentals, testing discipline, and communication skills are evident, but the gap to this specific mandate is too large.
strengths: Deep engineering fundamentals: TDD, CI/CD, low-latency systems, high-throughput microservices
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and course authorship
Broad polyglot adaptability across systems, backend, and infrastructure work
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, dated to 2014–2015
No Windows-platform development focus and no SQL Server/Oracle experience
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking/capital markets domain exposure
